Prepare a KC v9 export for analysis in one call

Source: R/config_kc9.R
kc9_prepare.Rd

Reads (or takes) a SurveyCTO wide export of the KC v9 form and returns a mapped vcs_data with card and recall evidence, child demographics linked from the roster, caregiver blocks attached to each child, and display labels for the stratifiers the report uses (residence_label, sex_label, education_label, zone_label).

kc9_prepare(
  data,
  n_caregivers = 3L,
  n_children = 3L,
  n_roster = 4L,
  weight = NULL,
  stratum = NULL,
  program_zones = NULL,
  keep_raw = TRUE,
  unit = c("interview", "roster"),
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A file path or a data frame (the raw export).

n_caregivers, n_children, n_roster

Repeat extents.

weight, stratum

Optional source columns; see kc9_dictionary().

program_zones

Optional character vector of health zones that make up the programme cohort; written to children$cohort.

keep_raw

Keep the raw export inside the result.

unit

What a row of the child table is. "interview" (default) keeps one row per completed child module – the analysis unit for coverage. "roster" keeps one row per child listed in the household listing (children repeat group), whether or not the module was done, and adds an interviewed flag; children never interviewed carry no vaccination evidence, so they enlarge denominators of response and eligibility but contribute nothing to card or recall coverage.

...

Passed to kc9_dictionary().

Value

A vcs_data object.

See also

Other KC v9 configuration: attach_child_variables(), kc9_besd_map(), kc9_caregiver_extras(), kc9_caregiver_to_child(), kc9_child_extras(), kc9_dictionary(), kc9_epi_doses(), kc9_labels(), kc9_link_roster(), kc9_recall_map(), kc9_schedule(), kc9_strata()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
vcs <- kc9_prepare("DRC_VxCoverage_WIDE.csv")
} # }
